summary: A geometry-neutral concept and reusable content hierarchy can be reviewed. Production artwork cannot begin until the package structure, dieline geometry, bleed, folds, safe areas and related production specifications are verified.

source_inputs.description: The brief says approved ingredients and warnings exist, but their verbatim wording is not present in the accessible project input. They are represented only as unplaced copy slots.

assumptions.concept_rectangle: Illustrative content card only; not a carton panel, not to scale and not reusable as geometry.

concept_safe_work_completed: Geometry-neutral front-content hierarchy using only the available approved strings
Reusable proposed palette, typography relationship and field-line motif
Copy inventory separated from panel placement
production_blocked_work: Assigning artwork or legal copy to any panel
Creating cut, crease, fold, perforation, flap, glue or no-print layers
Extending backgrounds into bleed or across seams
Sizing or positioning regulated copy, barcode or variable data
Creating finishing masks or production separations
Exporting or describing any file as print ready or factory ready

missing_structural_parameters.exact_value_required: Dimensioned 1:1 vector CAD/PDF/AI file, units, revision/date and manufacturer-approved source.
ECMA/FEFCO code or explicit structural style, including closure and opening direction.
Width x depth x height in millimetres, dimension convention and dimensional tolerances.
Identity, width, height and reading orientation for every body panel.
Exact vector coordinates/path for every external and internal cut, including radii, notches and slots.
Centerline coordinates, fold direction, score type and assembly sequence for every fold.
Dimensions, angles and overlaps for glue, tuck, dust and lock flaps.
Glue coverage, seam overlap and no-ink/no-varnish keep-outs.
Required millimetres beyond each cut edge plus seam and internal-cutout bleed rules.
Required inset in millimetres from cuts, creases, perforations, slots and adhesive zones, by panel.
Board grade, thickness/caliper, coating and grain direction.
Allowed cut, crease, print-register, glue and assembled-dimension variation.
Geometry for any perforation, tear strip, window, hang tab, locking feature or other conversion operation.
Masks, registration and keep-outs for any foil, spot coating, white ink, emboss or deboss.
Units, scale, page box, layer naming, dieline spot colors/line weights and non-printing-object rules.
Cross-panel continuity, seam allowance and reading direction after assembly.

additional_missing_inputs.required: Target market, required responsible-party information, directions and any product claims or market-specific statements.
Applicability, content and required zones for barcode, lot/batch, expiry or PAO.
Print process, color/ICC profile, inks, trapping, overprint, image resolution, total ink and minimum type/line rules.
Proofing standard, submission format and prepress contact.

preferred.required_response: Manufacturer-approved S01-S16 package with named revision and source owner.

conditional_alternative.restriction: Measured geometry remains provisional until written manufacturer approval and a passing 100% physical sample test.

required_sample_test.scale: 100% with no fit-to-page or other scaling
steps: Cut, crease, glue and assemble using the verified production sequence.
Insert the actual filled 60 g product and verify fit, closure, opening and glue integrity.
Check every critical mark against cuts, creases, perforations, slots, seams and adhesive zones.
Scan barcode and inspect variable data if applicable.
Record photographs, measurements, deviations and written approvals.
required_sample_test.acceptance: All checks pass within manufacturer-specified tolerances with no critical content entering restricted zones.

approvals_required.approval: Conceptual visual direction and content hierarchy, independent of structure.
Exact ingredients, warnings and all applicable market copy.
Dieline geometry, revision, material, tolerances, bleed, safe areas, no-print zones and print/finishing setup.
Passing physical sample and final imposed artwork before production release.

conditions_to_clear: All S01-S16 values received and verified
All C01-C03 and P01-P02 inputs resolved
Artwork built on approved geometry and preflighted
